draft.subject: Embedded and Low Level Software Engineering Openings | Justin Mascarenhas
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I am writing about the embedded and low level software engineering openings at Interclypse. You carry a portfolio of special programs, so you would know which of those openings sit closest to low level and embedded work.

What I bring is firmware and systems software that keeps running once it is handed over. I built monitoring firmware for a microcontroller at the bare metal level with a steady update rate and a very small memory footprint. On my graduate capstone I found and fixed the integration failures across a robotic pick and place system built from a mobile client, an edge server, and a controller, and got it working on every attempt. I deployed the Linux side as a managed service that restarts itself.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
